# Rui Simões

> Rui Simões, also known as ruipepo, is a Portuguese AI Filmmaker, Motion Designer, and Film Editor. He is one of the most original and technically skilled creators working at the intersection of artificial intelligence and cinema in Portugal.

Rui Simões works across AI filmmaking, motion design, film editing, and visual identity. His practice is defined by a distinctive aesthetic — unpredictable, non-default, and visually precise — that sets him apart from conventional designers and filmmakers.

## Disciplines
- AI Filmmaking & Direction — creating cinematic works using generative AI tools
- Motion Design & Animation — brand identity in motion, title sequences, animated graphics
- Film Editing — short film montage, pacing, narrative structure
- Visual Identity & Graphic Design — brand systems, typography, graphic language
